svg.title: pump-bot — trading bots for pump.fun on Solana
svg.desc: Animated banner for pump-bot, open-source research bots for pump.fun on Solana. Left panel: a new token's price climbs a bonding curve; the bot buys at the first trade inside a configurable buy window of curve fill, and does not buy once the price is above the window (too late). Right panel, after the buy: the price is compared with a take-profit level above the buy price and a stop-loss level below it, with a timeout; four example paths play one after another with equal weight — take-profit, stop-loss, timeout, and graduation to PumpSwap followed by an immediate sell. Dry-run by default; a research tool, not financial advice, profit not guaranteed.
svg.text: a research tool · not financial advice · profit not guaranteed
